name: memento
description: Turns photos of a real memory into character, item, environment sheets, a base frame, and paste-ready Dreamina video prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Recreate a personal memory from photos as a short AI film with Dreamina prompts.
interface.longDescription: memento interviews the user, extracts reference sheets and base frames from personal photos, and writes paste-ready Dreamina (Seedance) video prompts.
defaultPrompt: Use $memento to recreate this memory from these photos as a short Dreamina film.
Use $memento to turn these photos into a film with character, item, environment, and base-frame refs.
Use $memento to interview me about this memory and write paste-ready Seedance prompts.
